premise: On a windy afternoon a soft "hooo" comes out of the hollow log; Dragonfly thinks someone is snoring in there, Beetle tucks down flat, then bravely creeps up and peeks in — nobody — it is only the wind blowing through, so they hum along with it.
inspiration: The noise-in-the-night folk tale (the sound that turns out to be the wind) made sunny and small: the stranger is the wind, and it sings.
lesson: A brave little look turns a mystery into a song.

en-US.title: The Hooting Log
en-US.text: {log:enter} {canvas:wind 0.5} [curious] It was a windy afternoon. {log:live blow} {sfx:hoot} Hooo… A soft, hooting sound came out of the old hollow log. {dragonfly:enter} {dragonfly:go to log} Dragonfly zipped over to look. {dragonfly:live zigzag} Zig, zag, round the log she went. [excited] "Somebody's snoring in there!" {beetle:enter} {beetle:go to log} Beetle came too, but when he heard it… {sfx:hoot} hooo… {beetle:face surprised} {beetle:live tuck hold} he tucked down flat under his shell and kept very, very still. [whispers] "Who is it?" {dragonfly:face surprised} "Hello?" called Dragonfly into the log. Nobody answered. Only… hooo. [short pause] Beetle took a deep breath. {beetle:live tuck resume} He popped back up. Then, step by step, {beetle:go to log} he crept to the dark, round end of the log, and peeked inside. Nobody! Just a breeze, blowing in his face. Whoosh! {beetle:face happy} [laughs] "It's the wind!" laughed Beetle. "The wind is blowing through the log!" {log:live rustle} The little fern on top swayed. {dragonfly:face happy} So when the wind blew again… {log:live blow} hooo… Dragonfly and Beetle hummed along: {dragonfly:hop} {beetle:hop} hmmm… [happily] And that was the windy-day song of the hollow log. {canvas:wind stop}

es-ES.title: El tronco que ululaba
es-ES.text: {log:enter} {canvas:wind 0.5} [curious] Era una tarde de viento. {log:live blow} {sfx:hoot} Uuuh… Del viejo tronco hueco salía un sonido suave, como un ulular. {dragonfly:enter} {dragonfly:go to log} Libélula se acercó zumbando a mirar. {dragonfly:live zigzag} Zig, zag, dio vueltas al tronco. [excited] —¡Ahí dentro hay alguien roncando! {beetle:enter} {beetle:go to log} Escarabajo llegó también, pero al oírlo… {sfx:hoot} uuuh… {beetle:face surprised} {beetle:live tuck hold} se agachó bajo su caparazón y se quedó quieto, quietísimo. [whispers] —¿Quién será? {dragonfly:face surprised} —¿Hola? —dijo Libélula, asomándose al tronco. Nadie contestó. Solo… uuuh. [short pause] Escarabajo respiró hondo. {beetle:live tuck resume} Se levantó. Y luego, pasito a pasito, {beetle:go to log} se acercó a la boca oscura y redonda del tronco, y miró dentro. ¡Nadie! Solo una brisa que le soplaba en la cara. ¡Fiuuu! {beetle:face happy} [laughs] —¡Es el viento! —se rio Escarabajo—. ¡El viento sopla por dentro del tronco! {log:live rustle} El helechito de encima se meció. {dragonfly:face happy} Así que, cuando el viento volvió a soplar… {log:live blow} uuuh… Libélula y Escarabajo cantaron con él: {dragonfly:hop} {beetle:hop} mmmm… [happily] Y esa fue la canción del tronco hueco en los días de viento. {canvas:wind stop}
